name: hydra
description: Deterministic hydra routing for Claude Code. Routes a prompt that is exactly an ability's name or trigger (or $ability <name>) to that ability, delivers a rule the first time a file or command it covers is touched, and runs hydra's doctors so a stale library is named with the command that fixes it. Calls the hydra CLI for every decision and passes everything through when hydra is missing.

hydraPath.title: hydra binary
hydraPath.description: The hydra executable to run. Falls back to ~/.local/bin/hydra when this one cannot start.

hydraHome.title: hydra library
hydraHome.description: The global hydra library, for this mod's hydra processes. Empty (the default) resolves it as hydra does: HYDRA_HOME, else ~/.hydra. ~/ is allowed.

abilityRouting.title: Route abilities
abilityRouting.description: Attach an ability to a prompt that is exactly its name or one of its triggers, or $ability <name>.

ruleMode.title: Rule delivery
ruleMode.description: "off": rules are left to the instructions. "status": matching rules are named on the status line. "inject": a rule's text is also attached to the first tool result it applies to. "enforce" (default): as inject for reads, but the first edit, write or command a rule applies to is held once with the rule's text as the reason, so the rule is read before acting.

ruleLibraries.title: Extra rule libraries
ruleLibraries.description: More rules directories to match, as absolute paths separated by ':' (~/ allowed), e.g. ~/AI/dotfiles/rules. The project and global hydra libraries are always read.

maxInjectChars.title: Largest body inlined
maxInjectChars.description: A rule or ability longer than this many characters is delivered as a pointer to its file instead of inline.

doctorIntervalSec.title: Doctor staleness (seconds)
doctorIntervalSec.description: On a prompt, re-run hydra's doctors in the background when the last run is older than this, to catch edits made outside the session.

trustProjectRules.title: Deliver project rules
trustProjectRules.description: Deliver the text of rules from the project's own .hydra/rules. Off: project rules are only named on the status line, for repositories whose rules you have not reviewed.
